meta.name: aws-solution-architect
meta.description: Expert AWS solution architecture for startups focusing on serverless, scalable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure with modern DevOps practices and infrastructure-as-code

copy.tagline: 设计可扩展、低成本的云基础设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为初创公司设计 AWS 云架构
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing AWS cloud architecture for a startup

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计 AWS 云架构，生成可部署的模板、成本估算和安全检查清单，专注于无服务器、可扩展且成本优化的方案。
howto.when: 当你描述应用需求（如用户量、预算、合规要求）或要求优化现有 AWS 设置时触发。

say.text: 为我的移动应用设计一个无服务器后端，支持10万用户。
say.note: Claude 会给出架构图、模板和成本估算。

say.text: 帮我优化 AWS 成本，目标降低30%。
say.note: Claude 会分析当前资源并提供优化建议。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you design AWS cloud architectures, generate deployable templates, cost estimates, and security checklists, focusing on serverless, scalable, and cost-optimized solutions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe application requirements (e.g., user count, budget, compliance) or ask to optimize existing AWS setup.

say_en.text: Design a serverless backend for my mobile app with 100k users.
say_en.note: Claude will provide architecture diagram, templates, and cost estimate.

say_en.text: Optimize my AWS costs to reduce by 30%.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze current resources and suggest optimizations.
